transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Well, I guess I'm here because... ever since my father-in-law moved in with us, things have just been pretty strained. I've been snapping at my wife a lot over stupid little house things, which really isn't like me. And I'm putting off jobs and paperwork that I usually stay right on top of. 

It's just... I can't seem to get my head quiet. Even when I go out to the workshop to get some space, or when I'm trying to fish, my mind just won't shut off.
About how long has it been since your father-in-law moved in and you started feeling this way?
It's been about five months now. It all started pretty much shortly after he moved into the house.
Aside from feeling stressed and frustrated, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most days?
No, I wouldn't really say I feel sad or hopeless. It's not like that. I'm just... constantly wound up and irritated. But I don't feel down in the dumps or anything, just really stressed out.
Is your stress and worry focused mainly on the situation at home, or are you finding yourself excessively worrying about lots of different everyday areas, like your health, work, or finances?

It's really just the situation at home. I don't find myself worrying about my health or finances or anything like that. And, well, I'm not working right now, so there's no stress from a job. 

It's just... having him in the house. That's what is constantly on my mind. Everything else in my life is pretty much fine, it's just this one specific thing that has me feeling so tense all the time.
